ABOUT US

Sieve is a multimodal data lab building high-quality training datasets and evaluation environments for frontier AI across audiovisual modeling, robotics, and multimodal interaction. We pair exabyte-scale data infrastructure and global data collection operations with multimodal research to help machines learn how the world looks, sounds, moves, and responds. Our work spans real and virtual environments, from large-scale video and audio to human demonstrations and evaluations of reasoning and action. We believe data creation deserves the same rigor as model development, and that a close connection between data production, model training, and evaluation is essential to building AI that can understand and interact with the world.

We partner with top AI labs and did $XXM last quarter alone, as a team of ~45 people. We also raised our Series A from Tier 1 firms such as Matrix Partners, Swift Ventures, Y Combinator, and AI Grant.

 


WHY NOW

Sieve is one of the most capital-efficient teams in AI — roughly 30 people serving the world's leading AI labs across every major data modality. You'll join early, own problems end-to-end, and watch your work ship directly into the models defining the frontier.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Sieve, you’ll work on highly specific dataset problems for frontier AI labs. We're looking for someone with a strong bias to action who likes working closely with customers, untangling messy requirements, and shipping fast. 

You’ll work closely with customers and internal teams to understand exactly what data is needed, then turn ambiguous requirements into production systems that can find, generate, filter, transform, evaluate, and package high-quality video datasets at scale.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Comfortable working directly with customers or external teams to translate ambiguous needs into concrete technical systems

 - Strong Python developer with hands-on experience in PyTorch or similar ML frameworks

 - Experience building custom algorithms, model workflows, or large-scale data pipelines

 - Strong intuition for dataset quality, filtering, labeling, evaluation, and edge cases

 - Able to break customer-level goals down into the models, heuristics, infrastructure, and QA steps needed to deliver

 - Writes clean, maintainable code and can move quickly without creating brittle systems

 - Deep passion for video, media technologies, and frontier AI applications

 - Motivated by delivering end-to-end outcomes, not just training models or writing research code

 - Bonus: Experience with large-scale video, audio, or multimodal data processing

 - Bonus: Active contributor to open source projects

 - Bonus: Experience as an early hire at a startup

 - In-person at our SF HQ



BENEFITS

 - 401k + Full Health Insurance

 - Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner covered and your choice of snacks

 - Ubers covered home



*all roles at Sieve require you to be onsite in San Francisco 5 days per week
